destination.name: Lianyungang
destination.tagline: Yellow Sea port with the Monkey King's mountain, a sea island and waterfall valleys.
destination.description: Lianyungang is a Yellow Sea port in northeastern Jiangsu. Mount Huaguo, said to be the Monkey King's home in Journey to the West, reaches Jiangsu's highest point, and the Yuntai range has waterfalls and cliffs. Lian Island, Jiangsu's largest, is linked to the mainland by a long sea dyke. Kongwang Mountain holds Han-dynasty Buddhist carvings among the earliest in China.
whyVisit: Cross the sea dyke to Lian Island

goodToKnow.title: Seasonal ticket prices
goodToKnow.detail: Mount Huaguo costs ¥50 from December to February and ¥90 from March to November. Yuntai Mountain's ¥80 is for 20 April to 20 October.

goodToKnow.title: Getting in
goodToKnow.detail: The airport is at Baitabu, and the train station has direct trains to Beijing, Shanghai and other cities. Fenghuangwan beach is reached by train and bus.

goodToKnow.title: Museum closed Mondays
goodToKnow.detail: Lianyungang Museum is free to enter but closed on Mondays from April to October, so schedule it for another day.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Pleasant weather in {months} suits hiking and the coast, before hot rainy summers.
